Join: Link parent molecule_dictionary to molecule_hierarchy via parent_molregno. Link molecule_hierarchy to child molecule_dictionary via molregno. Link child molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Link child molecule_dictionary to compound_records via molregno. Link compound_records to activities via record_id. Link activities to assays via assay_id. Link activities to docs via doc_id. Link assays to target_dictionary via tid. Filter: parent chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL2105717'. target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3717'. standard_type equals 'IC50'. standard_units equals 'nM'.
